question: Does Akamatsu2020 expose a concrete load-adaptation versus non-adapting prediction involving network structure and internalization, and which observable/control and small public artifact could test it?
reason: Close reviewed source-recovery sequence; return to distinct active-network observable already nominated in CAP_LITERATURE, avoiding repeat theorem variants and missing-input audits.
scope: Bounded primary-source reading: exact comparison/control, simulation output versus experimental observable, one most informative follow-up or explicit inability. Primary article plus at most one linked public code/data landing page. No archive payloads, code execution, movies, installs, API costs or contacting authors.
acceptance_checks: Primary full-method/figure locator, label inference if only excerpt available
Actual adaptive/non-adaptive control and held-fixed quantities
Measured quantities versus simulated barbed-end/force variables
Data/code availability only as directly verified
No mechanism selection from a cap parameter subset or uncalibrated actin intensity
Independent review of proposed next experiment/data action
stop_condition: One source note and independent scope review or precise access/measurement gap; at most five minutes active source work and evidence cutoff. No reproduction or implementation.
